title: Meet food safety requirements
summary: This page explains the food safety responsibilities for businesses in NSW, depending on whether they are retail or operate in the food industry.
intro:
NSW food businesses have a responsibility to make sure the food they produce, process, store, distribute and sell is safe and correctly labelled.
